text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...How does it look? Is the ribbon in the 
back crooked?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's fine, looks perfect!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the dance studio, I saw Silence Suzuka 
and the others practicing while wearing 
their outfits for the commemorative live.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't we check if there are any 
parts of this costume that are hard to 
move in?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. Since we're here, let's try 
running through 'Never Looking Back' 
together. I'll go call the dance team 
over!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Practicing together was so fun~! 
Everyone's dancing was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes... an entire sea of blue reflected in 
the mirror... When everyone danced, the 
blue and white swayed like waves.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...It made my heart throb with excitement. 
So that's how we look from the audience's 
perspective.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not to be outdone by the dance, we've 
gotta sing just as coolly too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...But will just that be enough?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The commemorative live is different from a 
Winning Live, right? It's a special event, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
'A stage is only truly complete once the 
audience is there'... Someone said that 
before, and I think that's the kind of 
stage this is.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I think I understand. The atmosphere in 
practice and during the real live is 
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, why don't we try doing 
some visualization training for the actual 
live?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
We pump up our feelings just like it's the 
real thing, and sing while keeping that 
energy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think that's a good idea. Let's try 
image training.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the real performance, right 
before the show... We're waiting in the 
wings for it to begin. ...Will the 
pre-show announcement play?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-The pre-show announcement...! Uuu... 
I'm getting nervous already...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Soon, the background music fades down. 
The whole venue goes quiet!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The opening video plays... and comes to an 
end—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, onto the commemorative live 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Standing on stage, you see it... A sea of 
light, illuminated by countless penlights—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ........So beautiful........

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa~, I'm getting goosebumps...! I can 
hear the rhythmic clapping welcoming us!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The sea of light in the audience... was 
truly a wonderful sight. Looking at that 
scenery, it feels as if I could fly 
straight into the sky... Like a surge of 
boundless strength is welling up inside 
me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like I could keep singing 
forever!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In the mental image, I couldn't quite make 
out the audience's expressions, but... I 
hope they're all smiling.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's where we come in—we'll make them 
smile!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. So that we can reach a 
scenery even more magnificent than our 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Come, let's sing it one more time—

Silence Suzuka and the others continued 
their passionate practice. The 
commemorative live looked like it would be 
a stage hot enough to rival the scorching 
summer sun!
